title: Parity child group index formula
statement: Let $r,q$ be natural numbers, let $g$ be an index in $	ext{Fin}(r^q)$, and let $j$ be an index in $	ext{Fin}(r)$. The index assigned to the pair $(g,j)$ in $	ext{Fin}(r^{q+1})$ has value $g r+j$, where $g$ and $j$ denote their respective values.
